name: Can I install a sewer cleanout myself, or do I need a professional plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a sewer cleanout myself, or do I need a professional plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a sewer cleanout is a complex plumbing task that requires specialized tools, knowledge of plumbing codes, and experience with excavation. Incorrect installation can lead to leaks, sewer backups, or non-compliance with local regulations, potentially causing significant issues down the line. We strongly recommend hiring a licensed plumbing professional like CG Plumbing Solutions to ensure the job is done correctly, safely, and up to code.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sewer cleanout installation requires professional expertise due to its complexity, code compliance, and the risk of significant issues if done incorrectly.
